resources.string: An offline cashier for food and drink businesses. Every sale automatically reduces ingredient stock and works out your cost.
This name and address are printed on receipts and shown on the home screen. You can change them any time under More.
Enter the shop name to continue.
More detailed explanations per feature are under More, User guide.
Per-feature tutorials and the interactive tour
The screen dims and key parts are highlighted one by one. About a minute.
This is where you serve customers. Everything you need while selling is here.
Type a menu name to find it quickly.
Tap a category to filter menus. All shows every menu.
Tap + to add a menu to the cart. The cart bar appears below; tap it to pay.
Set up menus, recipes, ingredients and stock. A red dot means an ingredient needs attention.
Income, profit and expenses by period.
Shop profile, notifications, data backup, theme and language are here. Let us open it for a moment.
You are ready to sell! For more detailed tutorials per feature, open the User guide any time.
Tap a menu to add it to the cart, then pay.

string-array.name: gp1_steps
string-array.item: Tap + on a menu to add it, or find it with the search box.
Open the cart to change quantities, add notes or give a discount.
Tap Pay, choose cash or non-cash, then share the receipt.

resources.string: Every menu has a recipe, so cost and margin are calculated automatically.

string-array.name: gp2_steps
string-array.item: Open Manage, the Menus tab, then tap Add menu.
Enter the name, price, category and a photo if you have one.
Add ingredients and amounts per serving; the cost per serving shows right away.

resources.string: Ingredient stock goes down by itself with every sale.

string-array.name: gp3_steps
string-array.item: In Manage, the Ingredients tab, add each ingredient with its purchase unit.
Record purchases with Restock so average price and cost stay accurate.
Match physical stock with Stock count. You are notified when an ingredient runs low.

resources.string: See income, profit and expenses by period.

string-array.name: gp4_steps
string-array.item: Open Reports, then choose Today, 7 days, This month or Custom.
The Income tab shows sales, gross profit and best sellers.
The Expenses tab is for recording costs and viewing cash flow.

resources.string: Keep your data safe and set the app up your way.

string-array.name: gp5_steps
string-array.item: Back up regularly under More, Backup and restore, and keep the file outside the app.
Change the theme and language any time under More.
Open the User guide under More for detailed tutorials per feature.

resources.string: From picking a menu to sharing the receipt.

string-array.name: gt_sell_steps
string-array.item: Open Cashier mode. Find a menu with the search box, or filter with the category chips below it.
Tap + on a menu card to put it in the cart. Tap again to add more, or use the − and + buttons that appear on the card.
Press and hold a menu card to add a note, for example \"less sweet\".
Tap the cart bar at the bottom to open the details. You can change quantities, remove items and add a discount (amount or percent) there.
Tap Pay. For cash, enter Cash received or tap Exact amount; change is calculated for you. For non-cash, just choose Non-cash.
Tap Complete payment. On the success screen, share the receipt as text or an image, then tap New transaction.

string-array.name: gt_sell_tips
string-array.item: A menu marked Out of stock cannot be sold until its ingredients are restocked (you can change this policy in Manage, Ingredients, the three-dot menu).
Entered a sale by mistake? Open Reports, tap the transaction, then Void transaction. Stock is returned automatically.

resources.string: A recipe lets stock and cost work themselves out.

string-array.name: gt_menu_steps
string-array.item: Open Manage, the Menus tab, then tap Add menu.
Enter the name and selling price. Add a photo if you like (optional, resized automatically) and choose a category.
Under Recipe per serving, tap Add ingredient. Pick the ingredient, enter the amount for one serving and choose its unit (for example 2 tablespoons).
Repeat for every ingredient. The Cost and margin card shows cost per serving and margin percent as you fill in.
Tap Save. The menu appears at the cashier right away if it has a category and Active for sale is on.

string-array.name: gt_menu_tips
string-array.item: A menu without a recipe (for example bottled water) can still be sold; stock is not tracked and its cost counts as zero.
Turn off Active for sale to hide a seasonal menu without deleting its history.

resources.string: The ingredients, units and measures used in recipes.

string-array.name: gt_ingredients_steps
string-array.item: Open Manage, the Ingredients tab, then tap Add ingredient.
Enter the ingredient name and choose a Unit type: Mass (grams, kg), Volume (ml, litres) or Count (pieces). The type is locked once saved.
Choose the Purchase unit, the unit you normally buy in (for example kg or litre).
Set the Minimum stock. When stock reaches this level you get a notification.
If your recipes use kitchen measures, tap Add measure, for example \"tablespoon = 12 g\". It then appears as a unit choice in recipes.
If the ingredient already has stock, enter the opening stock and its value so cost is right from the start.

string-array.name: gt_ingredients_tips
string-array.item: An ingredient with history cannot be deleted, only archived, so past reports stay correct.
The OK, Low and Out markers in the list show which ingredients need buying.

resources.string: Record purchases and match stock with reality.

string-array.name: gt_stock_steps
string-array.item: Open Manage, the Ingredients tab, then tap the ingredient you want to update.
Tap Restock to record a purchase. Enter the quantity bought, its unit and the total price paid.
Tap Save restock. Stock goes up, the ingredient average price is updated and the purchase is recorded as an Ingredients expense.
To match stock, tap Stock count. Enter the real physical stock and choose a reason for the difference.
If the difference is waste, damage or spillage, turn on loss recording so it is counted as a loss.
The stock history below logs every sale, restock, void and stock count. Filter by 7 days, 30 days or All.

string-array.name: gt_stock_tips
string-array.item: Always enter the total price when restocking. Without a price, cost per serving cannot be calculated accurately.
Do a stock count regularly, say weekly, to keep the stock in the app equal to what is in the kitchen.

resources.string: Categories build the chips on the home screen.

string-array.name: gt_categories_steps
string-array.item: Open Manage, the Categories tab, then tap Add category and enter its name.
Set the order with the up and down arrows. The order here matches the chip order at the cashier.
Tap the three dots on a category to rename or delete it.
When deleting a category that has menus, choose a destination category so those menus do not disappear from the cashier.

string-array.name: gt_categories_tips
string-array.item: A menu without a category does not show at the cashier. The app warns you if there are any.

resources.string: Sales, gross profit and best sellers.

string-array.name: gt_income_steps
string-array.item: Open Reports, the Income tab. Choose a period at the top: Today, 7 days, This month or Custom (pick your own dates).
The big card shows Net sales (after discounts and without voided transactions).
The tiles below show Gross sales, Discounts, Ingredient cost (COGS) and Gross profit.
The chart shows sales per hour (today) or per day (longer periods).
Scroll down for Top menus, sales by category and by payment method.
The transaction list is at the end. Tap one to see its details, the profit on that sale, share the receipt or void it.

string-array.name: gt_income_tips
string-array.item: Gross profit = net sales minus the cost of ingredients used. Other costs such as rent and wages are counted in the Expenses tab.

resources.string: Operating costs, net profit and money in and out.

string-array.name: gt_expenses_steps
string-array.item: Open Reports, the Expenses tab, then tap Add expense.
Choose the date and category (Rent, Utilities, Wages, Packaging or Other), enter the amount and add a note if needed.
Tap Save. The expense appears in the list and is counted.
The Net profit card = gross profit minus operating costs. The Cash flow section shows money that actually came in and went out.
Tap the category icon at the top right to add or edit your own expense categories.

string-array.name: gt_expenses_tips
string-array.item: Ingredient purchases (restocks) are recorded automatically as Ingredients expenses and affect cash flow, but do not reduce profit because they are already counted as cost.

resources.string: Know about low ingredients before they run out.

string-array.name: gt_notifications_steps
string-array.item: Tap the bell icon at the cashier, or open More, Notifications. A dot on the More tab means something is unread.
You are told when an ingredient runs low (reaches minimum stock) and when it runs out, once per condition.
Tap the settings icon at the top right to turn each type of notification on or off.
On Android 13 and up, allow notifications when asked so alerts also appear outside the app.

string-array.name: gt_notifications_tips
string-array.item: Set each ingredient Minimum stock sensibly so you have time to buy before running out, without being nagged too often.

resources.string: Keep data safe even if the phone is lost.

string-array.name: gt_backup_steps
string-array.item: Open More, Backup and restore, then tap Create backup.
Choose a storage location outside the app, for example phone storage or a memory card. The file ending in .arnbak holds all your data and photos.
Choose a reminder (every 3, 7, 14 or 30 days) so you do not forget to back up.
To restore, tap Restore from file and choose an .arnbak file. The app checks the file is intact and shows a summary before you confirm.
Before replacing data, the app automatically keeps a safety copy. When done, the app restarts.

string-array.name: gt_backup_tips
string-array.item: The backup file is not encrypted and contains your sales data. Keep it somewhere safe and do not share it casually.
Delete all data on the same page empties the app (a safety copy is made automatically).

resources.string: Set up the identity and look of the app.

string-array.name: gt_profile_steps
string-array.item: Open More, then tap the profile card at the top to enter the business name, address, phone, logo and currency symbol. This is printed on receipts.
Tap Theme to choose Follow system, Light or Dark. Dynamic colour (Android 12 and up) takes colours from your wallpaper.
Tap Language to switch between Bahasa Indonesia and English. It takes effect right away without restarting.

string-array.name: gt_profile_tips
string-array.item: The logo shows on the home screen and can be changed any time.

resources.string: Trying the app with sample data
Fill the app with a fictional coffee shop.

string-array.name: gt_sample_steps
string-array.item: While the app is still empty, tap Try with sample data on the home screen. Or open More, Backup and restore, the Sample data section.
Choose a size: Small (3 days), Medium (14 days) or Large (45 days and thousands of history rows).
Wait until it finishes. The Large scenario takes about one to two minutes.
Explore Cashier, Manage and Reports with the data filled in.
To use real data, open Backup and restore, then Delete all data.

string-array.name: gt_sample_tips
string-array.item: Sample data can only be loaded while the app is empty, so it will never overwrite your business data.
